title: Order in the Court: Supreme Court’s good news for seafarers
summary: The High Court voids a section of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers that requires seafarers to pay a bond even if they already won their labor case against shipowners or agencies

blocks.text: The High Court voids a section of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers that requires seafarers to pay a bond even if they already won their labor case against shipowners or agencies
MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court voided Section 59 of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers.
This provision requires seafarers to pay a bond even if they already won their labor case against shipowners or agencies.

blocks.caption: SC declares parts of Magna Carta of Seafarers unconstitutional.  So what?
